## 08 lossless: lossless battery over the same 2048 source jpegs

### generations

| generation | bytes | MB | ratio | encode s | class | verification |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| jxl-transcode -e 7 (forge default, 02-av1-variants) | 189231744 | 189.2 | 1.12x | 74.7 | byte-reversible | 2048/2048 sha256 round-trips in the build |
| jxl-transcode-e9 | 187736464 | 187.7 | 1.12x | 493.2 | byte-reversible | 64/64 roundtrips sha256-ok |
| jpegtran-optimize | 209633615 | 209.6 | 1.01x | 74.7 | pixel-exact | 32/32 pixel-identical |
| jpegtran-progressive | 209633689 | 209.6 | 1.01x | 56.1 | pixel-exact | 32/32 pixel-identical |
| jpegoptim-strip | 211009267 | 211.0 | 1.00x | 16.5 | pixel-exact | 32/32 pixel-identical |
| webp-lossless | 803293814 | 803.3 | 0.26x | 335.0 | pixel-domain (decoded) |  |
| jxl-transcode+zstd19 | 188919603 | 188.9 | 1.12x | 1.4 | byte-reversible |  |
| video-ffv1-srcorder | 783186432 | 783.2 | 0.27x | 9.9 | pixel-domain (decoded) |  |
| video-ffv1-clusterorder | 783049555 | 783.0 | 0.27x | 9.0 | pixel-domain (decoded) |  |
| video-x264qp0-clusterorder | 699842163 | 699.8 | 0.30x | 11.6 | pixel-domain (decoded, yuv444) |  |

- three classes that must never be conflated: byte-reversible returns the original jpeg bytes; pixel-exact is a re-save with the same decoded pixels and different bytes; pixel-domain recompresses decoded pixels and always lands above the jpeg it came from.
- e9 over e7: -0.8% bytes for 6.6x the encode time; e7 stays the forge default.
- the lossless video rows lose 3.3x to 3.8x against the source jpeg (3.7x to 4.3x against jxl-transcode e9); semantic ordering moves ffv1 by 137 kB.
